content.text:
I've submitted index 12 (Sb fraction 0.257, close to the La3SbO7 composition) as the best composition. The choice is weak: none of the samples showed real photoactivity.

**EQE results (all 5 measurements used):**

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 12 | 0.257 | 0.00029 |
| 4 | 0.117 | 0.00023 |
| 21 | 0.505 | -0.00047 |
| 17 | 0.389 | -0.00094 |
| 28 | 0.682 | -0.00221 |

- **What the numbers mean:** every value is essentially zero. Index 12 had the highest reading, but its lead over the others is within the noise, so it isn't a meaningful winner. This fits what's expected of La–Sb oxides like La3SbO7 and LaSbO4: they have wide band gaps and absorb little or no light at 2.7 eV.
- **How I spread the measurements:** I measured compositions at both ends and in the middle of the line, near the known phases. I put the last measurement where the Gaussian-process model suggested (index 17), and it also came back at noise level.
- **XRD (2 of 5 used):** index 28 showed peaks from the film itself; index 16 was dominated by what look like substrate peaks. I didn't run pattern matching against the phase database, so the phases in these films aren't confirmed.

About 24 compositions on the line were never measured. Given how flat all five readings were, it seems unlikely any of them performs much better, but I can't rule it out.
